# About this script

**Preregistered analysis (main text; RQ4).** Joint models testing whether
the within- and between-person associations between TV viewing and sleep
differ across MIDUS samples: Model 4a compares MIDUS 2 and MIDUS 3 (the
same cohort at a later wave); Model 4b compares MIDUS 2 and MIDUS
Refresher 1 (a different cohort). Each is Model 2b plus wave/cohort
intercepts and wave/cohort-specific TV effects, with the random intercept
and random scale carried forward from Model 1b. Run the three structuring
scripts first.

Iterations were increased to meet the prereg ESS criterion (> 1000):
Model 4a uses 16000 iterations (4000 warmup); Model 4b uses 8000 (4000
warmup).

# Packages, data, and helper functions

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(brms)

M2_sample <- readRDS("../midus_2/M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard.rds")
M3_sample <- readRDS("../midus_3/M3_analysis_data_fulltime_standard.rds")
MR_sample <- readRDS("../midus_refresher/MR_analysis_data_fulltime_standard.rds")

model_output_dir <- "model_fits_cross_wave"
dir.create(model_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Prereg convergence criteria: R-hat < 1.01, bulk and tail ESS > 1000,
# and 0 divergent transitions (population-level, SD, and correlation
# parameters)
check_convergence <- function(fit) {
  draws_summary <- posterior::summarise_draws(
    as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^(b_|sd_|cor_|sigma$)", regex = TRUE),
    "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail"
  )

  tibble(
    max_rhat = max(draws_summary$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_bulk_ess = min(draws_summary$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_tail_ess = min(draws_summary$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
    divergent = sum(nuts_params(fit, pars = "divergent__")$Value)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      meets_prereg = max_rhat < 1.01 & min_bulk_ess > 1000 &
        min_tail_ess > 1000 & divergent == 0
    )
}

# Prereg assumption check: Q-Q plot of level-1 residuals
check_residual_normality <- function(fit, label) {
  resid_est <- residuals(
    fit,
    method = "posterior_predict"
  )[, "Estimate"]

  qqnorm(
    resid_est,
    main = paste0(label, ": Level-1 residual Q-Q plot")
  )

  qqline(resid_est)
}

# All samples are already restricted to full-time, standard shift
stopifnot(
  all(M2_sample$is_fulltime == 1), all(M2_sample$is_standard_shift == 1),
  all(M3_sample$is_fulltime == 1), all(M3_sample$is_standard_shift == 1),
  all(MR_sample$is_fulltime == 1), all(MR_sample$is_standard_shift == 1)
)
```

# Preparing each wave's sample

Within each wave, as in the single-wave models: age is mean-centered at
the participant level, TV is person-mean centered (`tv_within`), and each
person's TV mean is grand-mean centered across that wave's participants
(`tv_person_mean`).

```{r}
prepare_wave_sample <- function(data) {

  age_mean <- data %>%
    distinct(id, age) %>%
    summarise(m = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(m)

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      age_centered = age - age_mean
    ) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(
      tv_person_mean_raw = mean(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
      tv_within = tv_duration_minutes - tv_person_mean_raw
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Equally weighted mean of participants' TV means
  tv_grand_mean <- data %>%
    distinct(id, tv_person_mean_raw) %>%
    summarise(m = mean(tv_person_mean_raw, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(m)

  data %>%
    mutate(tv_person_mean = tv_person_mean_raw - tv_grand_mean)
}

M2_prepared <- prepare_wave_sample(M2_sample)
M3_prepared <- prepare_wave_sample(M3_sample)
MR_prepared <- prepare_wave_sample(MR_sample)

# QC: within-person deviations average ~0 per person; centered person
# means average ~0 per wave
bind_rows(
  M2 = M2_prepared, M3 = M3_prepared, MR = MR_prepared,
  .id = "wave"
) %>%
  group_by(wave, id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_tv_within = mean(tv_within, na.rm = TRUE),
    tv_person_mean = first(tv_person_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  summarise(
    max_abs_mean_tv_within = max(abs(mean_tv_within), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tv_person_mean = mean(tv_person_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

# Model 4a: MIDUS 2 and MIDUS 3

The same participants can appear in both waves, so each person's
wave-specific random intercepts and scales are allowed to correlate.

```{r}
data_4a <- bind_rows(
  M2_prepared %>% mutate(wave = "MIDUS2"),
  M3_prepared %>% mutate(wave = "MIDUS3")
)

data_4a$wave <- factor(
  data_4a$wave,
  levels = c("MIDUS2", "MIDUS3")
)

cat(
  "Model 4a data:\n",
  "MIDUS 2 participants:", n_distinct(data_4a$id[data_4a$wave == "MIDUS2"]), "\n",
  "MIDUS 3 participants:", n_distinct(data_4a$id[data_4a$wave == "MIDUS3"]), "\n"
)
```

```{r}
bf_model_4a <- bf(
  sleep_next_night_minutes ~
    0 + wave +
    weekend +
    age_centered +
    sex +
    wave:tv_within +
    wave:tv_person_mean +
    (0 + wave | c | id),

  sigma ~
    0 + wave +
    (0 + wave | c | id)
)

fit_4a <- brm(
  bf_model_4a,
  data = data_4a,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  # Iterations increased per prereg (ESS criterion)
  iter = 16000,
  warmup = 4000,
  seed = 2026,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  file = file.path(model_output_dir, "model_4a_m2_m3"),
  file_refit = "never"
)

summary(fit_4a, prob = 0.9)

fixef(fit_4a, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))

vc_4a <- VarCorr(fit_4a, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
vc_4a$id$cor[, "Estimate", ]
```

```{r}
# Wave difference in average sleep (prereg beta_4; 90% credible interval).
# Age is centered within each wave, so this compares each wave at its own
# average age (and average TV)
hypothesis(
  fit_4a,
  "waveMIDUS3 - waveMIDUS2 = 0",
  alpha = 0.10
)

# Wave differences in the TV effects (90% credible intervals)
hypothesis(
  fit_4a,
  "waveMIDUS3:tv_within - waveMIDUS2:tv_within = 0",
  alpha = 0.10
)

hypothesis(
  fit_4a,
  "waveMIDUS3:tv_person_mean - waveMIDUS2:tv_person_mean = 0",
  alpha = 0.10
)
```

# Model 4b: MIDUS 2 and MIDUS Refresher 1

Different people in each cohort, so each person has one random intercept
and one random scale.

```{r}
data_4b <- bind_rows(
  M2_prepared %>% mutate(cohort = "MIDUS2"),
  MR_prepared %>% mutate(cohort = "MIDUSRefresher1")
)

data_4b$cohort <- factor(
  data_4b$cohort,
  levels = c("MIDUS2", "MIDUSRefresher1")
)

# QC: MIDUS 2 and Refresher IDs never overlap, so `id` identifies a
# single person in the combined data
stopifnot(length(intersect(M2_prepared$id, MR_prepared$id)) == 0)

cat(
  "Model 4b data:\n",
  "MIDUS 2 participants:", n_distinct(data_4b$id[data_4b$cohort == "MIDUS2"]), "\n",
  "MIDUS Refresher 1 participants:", n_distinct(data_4b$id[data_4b$cohort == "MIDUSRefresher1"]), "\n"
)
```

```{r}
bf_model_4b <- bf(
  sleep_next_night_minutes ~
    0 + cohort +
    weekend +
    age_centered +
    sex +
    cohort:tv_within +
    cohort:tv_person_mean +
    (1 | c | id),

  sigma ~
    0 + cohort +
    (1 | c | id)
)

fit_4b <- brm(
  bf_model_4b,
  data = data_4b,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  # Iterations increased per prereg (ESS criterion)
  iter = 8000,
  warmup = 4000,
  seed = 2026,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  file = file.path(model_output_dir, "model_4b_m2_mr"),
  file_refit = "never"
)

summary(fit_4b, prob = 0.9)

fixef(fit_4b, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))

vc_4b <- VarCorr(fit_4b, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
vc_4b$id$cor[, "Estimate", ]
```

```{r}
# Cohort difference in average sleep (prereg beta_4; 90% credible
# interval). Age is centered within each cohort, so this compares each
# cohort at its own average age (and average TV)
hypothesis(
  fit_4b,
  "cohortMIDUSRefresher1 - cohortMIDUS2 = 0",
  alpha = 0.10
)

# Cohort differences in the TV effects (90% credible intervals)
hypothesis(
  fit_4b,
  "cohortMIDUSRefresher1:tv_within - cohortMIDUS2:tv_within = 0",
  alpha = 0.10
)

hypothesis(
  fit_4b,
  "cohortMIDUSRefresher1:tv_person_mean - cohortMIDUS2:tv_person_mean = 0",
  alpha = 0.10
)
```

# Model diagnostics (prereg convergence and residual checks)

```{r}
models <- list(
  fit_4a = fit_4a,
  fit_4b = fit_4b
)

sapply(models, nobs)

# Convergence: every row should show meets_prereg = TRUE
bind_rows(lapply(models, check_convergence), .id = "model")
```

```{r}
for (model_name in names(models)) {
  check_residual_normality(models[[model_name]], model_name)
}
```
